lines.trans: Your friend Osipenko called me, can you imagine?
He asks how I am doing.
He says he missed me very much.
Who else will take care of me?
He offered to replace you for me!
What? Has he lost his mind completely?
I said he's just a disgusting person.
I'm not some object after all!
Well, do you feel even a little better?
Thank you, but I'm still in pain.
You're rude, but I felt sorry for you.
Let me give you a back massage.
Lyolya, wait! Please don't touch me!
The doctor said I need complete rest.
But the doctor said to relax your muscles!

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: masculine noun referring to someone lacking manners

examples.text: Ты грубиян, но я тебя пожалела.
examples.trans: You're rude, but I felt sorry for you.

examples.text: Не обращай внимания на этого грубияна.
examples.trans: Don't pay attention to that rude person.

meanings.note: + infinitive: давай убирать = let's clean up

related.gloss: to give (the verb it comes from)

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: medical practitioner; often used as form of address

examples.trans: Doctor, I urgently need a cast.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it
заменить X на Y = replace X with Y

examples.trans: To replace arrest with a travel ban.

звонить.gloss: to call, to phone; to ring

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
declines like какой: какая-то, какое-то, какие-то
делать массаж = to give a massage

examples.text: Клавдия Викторовна приказала сделать ей массаж ног!
examples.trans: Klavdia Viktorovna ordered me to give her a foot massage!

examples.text: Но он слишком мерзкий, и я передумала.
examples.trans: But he is too disgusting, and I changed my mind.
The weather outside today is nasty.

examples.text: Но доктор сказал расслабить твои мышцы!
examples.trans: But the doctor said to relax your muscles!

examples.text: После тренировки у него болели мышцы.
examples.trans: His muscles ached after the workout.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence
short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job
+ prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

meanings.note: ты ещё пожалеешь! = you'll be sorry!

позаботиться.gloss: to take care of, look after

meanings.en: to look after, take care of

examples.trans: Who else will take care of me?

examples.text: Она всегда готова позаботиться о друзьях.
examples.trans: She is always ready to look after her friends.

meanings.note: оставить кого в покое = to leave someone alone

meanings.en: a bit easier, feeling better (comparative of легко)

meanings.note: полегче на поворотах! = take it easy!

examples.text: Ну что, тебе хоть немного полегче?
examples.trans: Well, do you feel even a little better?
Lie down for a while and you will feel a bit better.

examples.text: На столе стоял полный стакан воды.
examples.trans: A full glass of water stood on the table.
But you were offered a job.

meanings.note: often in parenthetical представляешь? = can you imagine?

examples.trans: Can you believe it, they forgot it in the oven!

examples.text: Ты даже не представляешь, как я устал.
examples.trans: You can't even imagine how tired I am.

examples.text: Но доктор сказал расслабить твои мышцы!
examples.trans: But the doctor said to relax your muscles!
A warm bath helps relax the muscles.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

сойти.gloss: to get off; (с ума) to go mad

meanings.en: to get off, to step down
сойти с ума = to go mad, to lose one's mind

examples.trans: What, have I lost my mind?

соскучиться.gloss: to miss, to grow lonely for

meanings.en: to miss someone (+ по + dat.), to start missing

examples.trans: Do you think I didn't miss you?

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: сойти с ума = to go mad, lose one's mind
дай хоть одну = give me just one

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
